SELECT p.actor_id, p.display_name, p.email, p.phone_number, p.status, p.version, p.created_time, p.updated_time FROM organization_member_profile p INNER JOIN organization_membership m ON m.actor_id = p.actor_id AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND p.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY p.display_name ASC, p.actor_id ASC

SELECT p.actor_id, p.display_name, p.email, p.phone_number, p.status, p.version, p.created_time, p.updated_time FROM organization_member_profile p INNER JOIN organization_membership m ON m.actor_id = p.actor_id AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.department_id = #{departmentId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND p.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY p.display_name ASC, p.actor_id ASC
